reviews.title: Works great
reviews.comment: I bought this for my wife’s laptop and it works great. I didn’t install the heatsink but with it being on a laptop it runs cool enough. The ssd is fast for a non-name brand and for the price is well worth buying as long as you don’t need a top brand but fast ssd. Would buy again.
